instruction: Working with Abaqus/CAE, complete the provided block-on-plate nonlinear contact seed model in the N-mm-MPa unit system. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\Contact-Seed.cae; do not rebuild or replace its preloaded geometry, material, section, assembly, named surfaces, or named sets. The seed contains an unmeshed 10 mm x 10 mm x 12 mm 3D deformable Block, an unmeshed 30 mm x 30 mm x 4 mm 3D deformable Plate, Steel with E = 210000 MPa and nu = 0.3, the Steel-Solid homogeneous solid section assigned to both parts, and dependent instances with BLOCK-1 centered on PLATE-1: block X/Y = 10..20 mm and Z = 4..16 mm, plate X/Y = 0..30 mm and Z = 0..4 mm. Preserve the named regions SURF_BLOCK_TOP, SURF_BLOCK_BOTTOM, SURF_PLATE_TOP, SET_PLATE_BOTTOM, SET_BLOCK_GUIDE_A, and SET_BLOCK_GUIDE_B. Analysis: create a Static, General step named Step-Contact after Initial with Nlgeom = ON, initial increment 0.05, maximum increment 0.1, minimum increment 1e-8, and at most 200 increments. Contact: create one finite-sliding Surface-to-Surface Contact (Standard) interaction active in Initial, using SURF_PLATE_TOP as the main surface and SURF_BLOCK_BOTTOM as the secondary surface; use one interaction property with Hard normal contact, separation allowed, and frictionless tangential behavior. Boundary conditions: apply ENCASTRE to SET_PLATE_BOTTOM; to remove only the block's frictionless in-plane rigid-body modes, set U1 = U2 = 0 on SET_BLOCK_GUIDE_A and U2 = 0 on SET_BLOCK_GUIDE_B, leaving U3 unconstrained on both guide sets. Load: in Step-Contact apply a uniform positive pressure of 5 MPa to SURF_BLOCK_TOP, acting inward/downward; the 100 mm2 loaded area gives a 500 N resultant. Mesh: use structured HEX C3D8R elements, a 2 mm global seed on Block, and a 3 mm global seed on Plate; generate both meshes. Output: request U, S, RF, and contact stress output so the solved ODB contains CPRESS for the required contact pair. Job and deliverables: create and submit Job-Contact, wait for successful completion, verify nonzero displacement, Mises stress, and CPRESS results and pressure/reaction equilibrium, then save the completed database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Contact.cae with the solved output database at C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Contact.odb.
